musicians.name: Lee
bio: Lee is a professional singer-guitarist specialising in private and corporate events. Blending modern hits, classic anthems and Irish favourites, he delivers high-energy, singalong sets tailored to each event.
Known for seamless medleys and having fun with the crowd, he keeps the dance floor full from start to finish and happily takes requests.

musicians.name: Matthew
bio: Hailing from the West of Ireland, Matthew is a seasoned musician known for bringing energy, atmosphere and unforgettable live performances to events across the country.

With years of experience playing hundreds of shows, appearances on national TV and performances at major festivals, he combines powerful vocals with top-class guitar playing to keep every crowd entertained from start to finish.

musicians.name: Conor C
bio: With over eight years of experience and performances at more than 1,000 events across Ireland, Conor has developed a versatile show that can be tailored to your specific needs.
Unlike most solo performers, Conor uses a unique set of tools and techniques to create a fully live music experience that cannot be replicated.

musicians.name: Conor T
bio: Conor has nearly a decade of experience performing at events across Ireland and internationally.
Through this, he has built a unique and lively sound which gives the energy of a full band in a more personal setup. He also covers a wide mix of hits to keep the night flowing.

musicians.name: Cathal
bio: Cathal is a professional singer and guitarist with over ten years' experience on some of Ireland and the UK's biggest stages.
Whether you want a relaxed, mellow atmosphere early in your event or an upbeat, feel-good vibe later into the night, Cathal has the setlist for you.

musicians.name: Josh
bio: Josh is an incredibly talented musician who has performed at events and festivals all across Ireland.

Playing a mix of Irish favourites and dance classics on guitar, he creates the perfect atmosphere for any evening. With years of experience entertaining crowds, Josh brings great energy and plenty of craic to every event.

musicians.name: Emmett
bio: Emmett is a professional singer-guitarist specialising in private and corporate events across Ireland.

With a relaxed acoustic style and a repertoire spanning modern chart hits, timeless classics and Irish favourites, he creates the perfect atmosphere for every event. Every performance is tailored to suit the guests, so the music feels personal and memorable.

musicians.name: Alan
bio: Alan is a singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist who has won two National Song Contests as well as an IMRO award.
Alan has played with some of the biggest acts in Ireland and the UK, including The Coronas, Mundy, 5ive and Aslan, and has been playing music all over the world for the past 15 years.
He plays a wide range of music from the 60s up to the hits of today, as well as some traditional music, to make the perfect soundtrack to your event.

musicians.name: Paddy
bio: Paddy is a Galway-based musician with over 10 years of experience playing live events.
He's known for keeping things relaxed while still getting people on the dance floor, mixing crowd favourites with a few personal touches and the occasional harmonica.

musicians.name: Craig
bio: Craig is a live musician known for his strong vocal ability and high-energy performances.
With a natural talent for reading the crowd, he keeps the vibe upbeat and engaging from start to finish.
With years of experience entertaining crowds across Ireland, he has built a setlist featuring modern hits, creative mashups and classic singalong favourites.

musicians.name: Pauric
bio: Pauric is an incredibly gifted guitarist and outstanding singer who brings the perfect atmosphere to any setting.
His style blends popular contemporary songs with touches of traditional Irish music, creating a warm, lively and memorable experience for guests of all ages.
Whether performing laid-back acoustic favourites or getting everyone up dancing and singing along, Pauric's talent, charm and love of music make him a highlight of any event.

musicians.name: Karl
bio: Karl is a Dublin-based singer, guitarist and multi-instrumentalist with over 18 years of professional performing experience.
Since beginning his career on the Irish pub circuit in 2008, Karl has performed at more than 1,000 private events and corporate functions across Ireland, Europe and South America.
Whether it's creating the perfect atmosphere for a relaxed event or getting a crowd singing along late into the evening, Karl tailors every performance to suit the occasion.

musicians.name: Andrew
bio: Andrew is an experienced Irish musician who has performed at events across Ireland and the U.S.
Known for his relaxed style and wide-ranging setlist, he adapts to every crowd, whether it's the perfect soundtrack for a drinks reception or getting guests singing along later in the evening.
He has an incredible voice and is passionate about live music, bringing great energy to every event.

musicians.name: James
bio: James is an incredibly talented guitarist and vocalist, bringing a relaxed style, great energy and a wide range of popular songs to private events.
With a passion for live music, James creates the perfect atmosphere and keeps guests entertained throughout the occasion.

musicians.name: Cian
bio: Cian, a Mayo-born musician, has been singing and playing the guitar for two decades and is a familiar face in the lively Temple Bar area.
He enjoys playing a mix of modern and classic songs in rock, pop and folk styles. With dynamic and engaging performances, Cian has captivated music lovers throughout Ireland and abroad.

musicians.name: Phil
bio: Whether it's upbeat party music or laid-back acoustic vibes, Phil has all the bases covered. With a huge repertoire of over 700 songs, he is more than happy to take requests and be your very own human jukebox.
He has toured and performed across the UK, Ireland, Europe and America as a guitarist and vocalist with the legendary Sinéad O'Connor, making him incredibly experienced and ideal for any occasion.

musicians.name: Aaron
bio: Aaron is a solo singer-guitarist who plays parties and private events all over Ireland. His sets are made for the dance floor: upbeat and feel good, moving from current chart hits to party anthems and much-loved classics without a break in the energy.

He reads a room well and adjusts the set to suit it, so guests are singing along from the first song to the last. Requests are always welcome, which helps every event feel like it was put together just for you.

musicians.name: Keith
bio: Keith is a talented guitarist and singer with a real love for traditional Irish music. Whether it's a lively trad set, much-loved Irish ballads or a few modern favourites with a trad twist, he brings a warm, authentic feel that gets everyone involved.

musicians.name: Modern Trad Band
bio: Performing as a two-piece or three-piece, our Modern Trad Band blends current songs with Irish favourites as well as trad instrumentals.
Perfect as a stand-alone act or as an add-on to one of our solo musicians, the band is completely customisable to suit your event.

musicians.name: Jazz Band
musicians.cardText: Elegant live jazz for dinners, receptions and awards.
bio: Performing as a 3, 4 or 5-piece band, our house jazz ensemble brings elegant, sophisticated live music to corporate events. With a versatile line-up and refined playing style, the band can be tailored to suit the size, atmosphere and requirements of your event.

Perfect for corporate dinners, awards ceremonies, networking events, conferences, receptions and company celebrations, our flexible setup provides the ideal musical backdrop for any professional occasion.

musicians.name: Show Band
musicians.cardText: A high-energy live show with up to 7 musicians.
bio: Our show band delivers a high-energy live performance with a versatile line-up of up to 7 musicians, combining powerful vocals, exceptional musicianship and an engaging stage presence.
With a repertoire spanning classic anthems, soul, funk, pop and modern party favourites, the band is designed to bring the energy and entertainment to your event.

musicians.name: DJ
musicians.cardText: Keep the dance floor full all night.
bio: Keep the celebrations going with a professional Orcha Events DJ who knows how to create an unforgettable party atmosphere.
Our experienced DJs read the room and keep the dance floor packed from the first song to the very last. Every DJ set includes professional audio and lighting.
Want to take it further? Add a live saxophonist or karaoke to your DJ set.

musicians.name: DJ & Sax
musicians.cardText: A DJ with a live sax player. A live twist on the party.
bio: Take your DJ set to the next level with one of our talented live saxophone players.

Combining the energy of a live sax performance with the seamless flow of a professional DJ set creates an unforgettable atmosphere for you and your guests. Our saxophonists blend effortlessly with the music and adapt to the mood of the event.
It's the perfect way to add a unique, vibrant and sophisticated touch to your event.

musicians.name: Karaoke
musicians.cardText: A DJ with karaoke. Hand the mic to your guests.
bio: Hand the mic to your guests with our karaoke add-on, run alongside your DJ.

It includes fully licensed karaoke software with thousands of high-quality backing tracks across every genre, plus professional sound equipment, microphones and everything needed for a smooth, fun karaoke session.
Karaoke can be added to any DJ booking.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Everything you need to know about planning your event with us. Can't find your answer? Send us a message and we'll get back to you.

items.a: We look after the parts that make an event: live entertainment, the venue and catering through our partners. One team takes care of everything, from your first enquiry to the night itself.

items.q: What kinds of events do you look after?
items.a: Corporate events, Christmas parties, awards and gala dinners, product launches, birthdays and private parties. If you're planning something else, tell us about it.
We work with clients across Ireland and Europe.

items.q: Can you find us a venue?
items.a: Yes. Tell us your date, guest numbers and the kind of event you have in mind and we'll suggest venues that suit. Have a look at some of our favourite venues.
Yes. We work with trusted catering partners and can arrange food to suit your event, from canapés to a full dinner. Just let us know what you have in mind when you enquire.
Solo singer-guitarists, a modern trad band, a jazz band, a show band, DJs, DJ and sax, and karaoke. Watch videos of all our musicians.
Every event is different, so we quote each one individually. For live music you can see starting prices on our packages page, or send us your details and we'll put together a quote.

items.q: How far in advance should we book?
items.a: As early as you can, especially for Fridays, Saturdays and December, which book up months ahead. If your date is close, still get in touch, as we can often help at short notice.

items.q: What if a performer can't make it?
items.a: You're covered by our musician replacement guarantee. If your musician is ill or can't perform for any reason, we'll arrange a replacement of the same standard from our roster, so your event goes ahead with great live music.
